pages.title: There, Then, and Back Again
pages.text: Bring time travel, sea travel and a recorded discovery into one expedition career.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Complete these in any order. A photograph must have a real image identifier; an empty photo item does not qualify. This is a representative expedition finale, not a demand to finish every branch.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Mountain chains, underground rivers, unusual biomes and the tall End need different routes. Generation changes appear in new chunks. Ordinary granite, diorite and andesite also occur in restored blobs; andesite supports workshop recipes.
